---
title: Pinned lines
---

::: a quote from the book, big and centered -> quote size=large align=center
Not all those who wander are lost.
:::

::: a quote with who said it -> quote cite="J. R. R. Tolkien"
All that is gold does not glitter.
:::

::: words with -> an arrow in them -> callout kind=aside
Only the last arrow is the pin.
:::

::: a pin that is not plain form -> quote big!
Left as text.
:::

::: a part that does not exist -> blockquote size=large
Left as text.
:::

::: a value that is not allowed -> callout kind=shout
Left as text.
:::
